tex_content.html:
Theorem

1. ch6:6.9Let $M$ and $N$ be smooth $n$-manifolds with or without boundary. If $F:M\to N$ is smooth and $A\subseteq M$ has measure zero, then $F(A)$ has measure zero in $N$.

Proof

\sketch Cover $M$ by countably many smooth charts $(U_i,\varphi _i)$. For each smooth chart $(V,\psi )$ of $N$,

\[ \psi (F(A)\cap V) =\bigcup _i(\psi \circ F\circ \varphi _i^{-1}) \bigl(\varphi _i(A\cap U_i\cap F^{-1}(V))\bigr). \]

Every set on the right is null by Proposition 6.5, and a countable union of null sets is null.

□
